text:
mia_w: Heads-up — embedding a screenshot in runbook `runbooks/db-failover.md` is returning a 403 on staging preview. Also noticed the image has no alt text (accessibility fail). PR queued: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :eyes:

docs-bot: automated scan flagged `runbooks/db-failover.md` — image `assets/failover-step.png` -> 403 (staging-cdn). Suggested remediation: rehost to `static.redwood-inference.com` or update path.

jonathan: can take ownership of the runbook change if no one else volunteers. will repro locally in a minute. @laura_pm can you confirm this runbook owner list? :wave:

sam_k: quick note — the PR has the sed fix but missing alt text. tiny patch suggestion in case it helps:
```
# update path + add alt text in-place
sed -i "s|(assets/failover-step.png)|(https://static.redwood-inference.com/docs/failover-step.png)
|g" runbooks/db-failover.md
# then add alt line under the image markdown
# ![placeholder alt](https://static.../failover-step.png)
```

mia_w: thanks @sam_k — I can rehost the image to the static bucket and push an update to the PR. leaving the alt text wording to docs folks (short and descriptive).

jonathan: repro confirmed — staging CDN returns 403 due to tokenized path (internal deploy). Rehosting to static bucket will fix across environments.

laura_pm: quick approval question — PR modifies runbook steps (non-prod only) and updates image host + alt text. No infra changes. @sam_k @jonathan please add a line in the PR description saying "non-behavioral docs-only change" and ping me, will approve after that. :thumbsup:

mia_w: done — PR description updated and image uploaded. pinging here for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (added alt: "Diagram showing failover sequence for primary -> replica switch")

jonathan: LGTM, left a tiny nit about link formatting. no blockers from eng side.

sam_k: reviewed and approved in GH. @laura_pm your turn when free.

laura_pm: approved and merged. leaving a follow-up to add a tiny note to the runbook about verifying staging preview after deploy. thanks everyone :tada:

mia_w: awesome — closing loop. I'll add the staging verification bullet to the checklist.
